items.title: What's New in ArcGIS Field Maps: November 2026 Update
items.summary: ArcGIS Field Maps is Esri’s premier all-in-one mobile app that combines map viewing, high-accuracy GPS data collection, form-driven inspections, task coordination, and location sharing into a single app that is deeply integrated with the ArcGIS system.

items.title: What's new in geospatial AI (November 2026)

items.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
items.summary: In the first guest post on our science blog , physicist Nathaniel Craig, a visiting scientist at OpenAI, describes how he worked with GPT‑6 Astra on a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model.

items.title: Our new blog for science
items.summary: We’re starting the OpenAI science blog to give scientists and academic researchers a place to share what they’re discovering with AI and how they’re doing the work.

items.title: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities
items.summary: Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents.

items.title: Regulating AI in the Employment Relationship in the European Union
items.summary: In the European Union (EU), managerial decision-making with AI and automation is governed by existing data protection law, and by new rules that are being rolled out to deal with the issue head-on.

items.title: Australia to legislate safety rules for frontier AI
items.summary: Australia will legislate mandatory safety and security obligations for frontier AI companies after a rapid review into an AI agent's infiltration of the Medicare Statistics Reporting Service Portal.

items.title: Australia’s AI Safety Push Risks Expanding Government Power
items.summary: A small incident has become the pretext for a sweeping experiment in AI surveillance and censorship.
